tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (kha)༄༅/ /'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sgom bzlas 'phags pa bzhad pa'i rol gar zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /mtha' klas rgyal ba'i mkhyen pa rgya mtsho'i 'jing*/
(kha)༄༅/ /'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sgom bzlas 'phags pa bzhad pa'i rol gar zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /mtha' klas rgyal ba'i mkhyen pa rgya mtsho'i 'jing*/

tei:div.tei:p: (kha)༄༅// 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sgom bzlas 'phags pa bzhad pa'i rol gar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// mtha' klas rgyal ba'i mkhyen pa rgya mtsho'i 'jing*// pha mtha' bral ba'i pha rol bder gshegs la// 'jam mgon smra ba'i bla mas rnam kun tu// mkha' mnyam yid can blo gros dge bar mdzod// 'dir rmongs pa'i shugs drag ring por 'bab pas mun pa'i rgyun la ngal 'tsho bar rloms pa'i ma rnams bde bar sbyor ba'i slad du shes rab kyi mig bla na med pa bsten par bya ste/ de yang gsang ba zab mo'i rig sngags kyi khyad par la brten nas myur du sgrub pa'i thabs kho na mchog tu mthong bas re zhig 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs nye bar sgrub pa'i thabs bshad par bya'o// sdom ni/ skyabs gsol ba dang byang sems bzung*// tshogs bsags tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom// lha bskyed sngags bzlas las sbyor sgrub// rjes kyi bya ba rnams kyis bsdus// de la dang po ni/ gang la skyabs zhu ba'i yul phyogs bcu'i dkon mchog rnam pa gsum mdun du bltas la ngag tu/ gang la brten na don mchog 'dod 'jo'i gzhi// skabs gnas dpag bsam dbang po'i grib bsil du// deng nas rmongs pa sogs kyi gdung ba kun// nye bar zhi slad yongs su bsti bar bgyi// gnyis pa ni/ brtse ldan mgon po rnams kyi spyan snga ru// bdag gis ma rnams yang dag bsgral ba'i phyir// byang chub snying po'i dpal 'byor mngon 'dod pas// smra ba'i seng ge bsgrub pa'i yi dam gzung*// gsum pa ni/ rang mdun nam mkhar skad cig la// rnam gsum dad pa'i pho nya yis// spyan drangs 'jam dpal gzhon nu ni// sras bcas rgyal bas bskor bar gsal// na ma shrī gu ru mañdzu shrī ye/ srid dang zhi ba'i mtshan ma ni// pad dkar zla ba'i steng byon pa'i// skye med a yig las skyes sku// bcom ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dran pas sdig pa'i dri ma ni// rnam sbyangs dkar ba'i reg pa 'dzum// thugs brtses bzhad pa'i zla zhal can// bcom ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mtha' dag rgyal ba'i zhing dang sku// mkhyen pa'i snying por bskrun pa las// rtag tu gzhon nu'i lang tsho can// bcom ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gang du khyod kyi phrin las kyi// 'bab stegs mos pa mngon mtho ba// de der gzigs pa phyogs lhungs bzhin// bcom ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// lan gcig yid mkhar shar bas kyang*// nyin dang mtshan du rab gsal ba'i// blo gros snang ba'i mdzod gtad pa// bcom ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/

gzhan yang*/ tshigs bcad 'os rigs kyis phyag bya/ bsam sbyor gyi dri ma spangs ba'i mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod dpag tu med par oṃ yig las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho mkha' ltar klas shing 'grib pa med pa'i rang bzhin can du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai bi d+yaṃ/ shab+da aḥhūm̐/ bar gyi byin gyis brlab/ dbul tshig ni/ yan lag brgyad ldan mtho ris klung gi rgyun// gdung ba'i rig pa bsnyil bar 'dod pa'i 'dzum// mu tig tshar du dngar 'dra lbu ba'i rtser// chags pa yid kyis bkug nas mchod yon bya// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye aḥhūm̐/ nyes pa'i rdul dang lhan cig mi gnas pa'i// zhabs mthil bye ru'i 'dab brgya grol ba'i ngogs// mtha' yas skye dgu'i ra ri sbyang ba'i slad// skal ldan shing rta'i mgron gyis brlan par bgyi// pā d+yaṃ pra tī= sum rtsen sgeg mo'i mig zur sgra 'dzin dag /so sor 'os zhes mi mthun sgrogs pa las// de de'i skal ba'i lam du ma chud pa// mngon 'dod gzugs can me tog char du bsnyil// puṣ+paṃ pra tī= ma la ya yi rlung gzhon spun zla ru// skyes sam yang na srid pa'i dri mchog kun// gcig tu byas zhes som nyi'i blo ster ba// bdug pas phyogs kyi go skabs dog por bya// dhū paṃ pra tī= nyi ma bye ba phrag brgya'i khengs pa kun// cig char 'joms byed rin chen sgron me'i tshogs// shes bya'i pha mtha' gzigs pa'i spyan ras kyi// dga' ston spel phyir stong gsum mtha' la klas// dī paṃ pra tī= tshul khrims yongs su rdzogs pa'i bsung zhim pos// nam yang khyod sku'i mdzes pa snyod mi srid// 'on kyang sgrub po nyon mongs dri nga dang*// 'bral bar rings nas bzang po'i byugs pa 'bul// gan+dhaṃ pra tī=

mar dang 'o ma sbrang rtsi sha kha ras// spags pa'i sā lu'i zhal zas 'da' dgu'i mchog /mgon po'i ljags kyi pad+mar rjes mthun pas// dal med yang dang yang du bkur bsti bya// nai wi d+yaṃ pra tī= ma lus rab skyes rnams kyi sgra 'dzin gang*// bcud kyis 'gengs byed zin dang ma zin sgra// mnyam par bsdebs pa'i dbyangs bdun rab rdzogs pa// rol mo'i mchod pa srid rtse'i bar du btags// shab+da pra tī= /kun tu bkra shis byed pa'i mtshan ma brgyad// phun tshogs 'khor los sgyur ba'i rin chen bdun// mthong thos snom myang reg dang sems pa yis// dga' skyed mtha' dag grangs med sprul te mchod// bi bi dhārtsa tsa naṃ pra tīts+tsha sogs kyis mchod/ bshags pa ni/ 'dod khro gti mug dbang gis ni// bdag gis sdig pa sna tshogs bgyis// mi bzad 'bras bus 'jigs gyur pas// 'phags pa'i spyan sngar smrengs te mthol// nongs pa 'di yis 'gro kun gyi// nongs pa rab tu zad byas nas// phyin chad bdag gzhan sdig med cing*// shes rab spobs pa gsal gyur cig /gang la bsgrib dang gang gis sgrib// bsgribs pa rnams kyi rang bzhin gang*// brtags pas rnyed min ngo bo nyid// nam mkha'i khams ltar dag pa'o// yan lag lhag ma ni/ rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi phrin las phul// grangs med bkod mar zla brnyan bzhin// mkha' mnyam skye 'phags dge tshogs kyi// sgyu 'phrul rnams la rjes yi rang*// thar pa'i lam mchog mi snang la// sgron me dang ni lam zhugs rnams// myur du bgrod pa'i sa mkhan du// thugs rjes dam chos ston par gsol// 'phags rnams sprul pa sna tshogs kyis// sna tshogs thabs la dbang sgyur slad// skye 'jig mtshan ma mi ston par// thar 'dod 'dod pa mthar phyin mdzod// bdag gis dus gsum dge bsags pa'i// bdog pa mchis gyur sems can rnams// byang chub snying por 'gro ba yi// 'tsho ba dam pa nyid gyur cig

/badz+ra muḥs tshogs zhing gshegs/ bzhi pa ni/ mkha' mnyam ma rnams bde dang ldan// sdug bsngal kun bral dga' chen pos// rtag par tshims shing rang gzhan rnams// chags sdang bral bar snyoms gyur cig /ces tshangs gnas yun ring du bsgom/ lnga pa ni/ oṃ swā bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dhārmaḥswā bha wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas chos kyi de kho na nyid nges par byas nas/ mtshan ma kun bral chos dbyings rang bzhin las// brtse chen sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i zlos gar ni// bde ldan zhing gi grogs por 'os pa'i ljongs// dbyar skyes gzhon nus khebs pa'i ne'u gseng*// gangs ri'i dbang po skyod par 'khrul pa yi// lag ldan dud 'gro'i gnas las ring son pa// thabs dang shes rab mche ba la brten nas// mang thos sna zhags sring ba'i brda mkhan dang*// gtsug na zla ba'i mgrin pa ltar sngo ba'i// spu sdug gis g.yogs 'phags pa'i shes rab bzhin// myur 'gro bden bzhi'i rmigs pa cher brling ba// cang shes tshogs kyi nor bu'i phra tshom bstar// stong nyid bcu drug la sogs chos kyi sgra// snyan mngags rol mor sbyar ba'i glu dbyangs mkhan// bya khyung dkar dmar khyo shug phreng ba yis// phyogs kyi dpal mo'i rgyan du byas pa der// bam̐ las ston mtshan zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*// dkar ba thun mong nyid gyur pad+ma can// 'khor ba'i rmongs pa bgrungs pa'i legs byas tshogs// gcig car rdzogs pa bzhin du gang ba'i dbus// pam̐ yig las skyes pad+ma'i sdong bu ni// rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i snying stobs las byas bzhin// sna tshogs nor bu'i yal 'dab khyon yangs pa// rig sngags grub pa rnams kyi las thabs bzhin// gser gyi 'dab ma 'bum phrag bzhad pa yis// ge sar mtshams sprin rdul dmar 'thungs pa bzhin// de yi mdzes pas rab brten ri bong can// snying brtse'i cha shas rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor la// a yig dkar po gnas pa las 'phros pa'i// 'od kyis 'gro ba rnams kyi gti mug sogs// ming gi lhag ma'i gnas kyang 'phrog byas nas// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mtha' dag rab mchod cing*/

srog gi yi ge la zhugs yongs gyur pa// bdag nyid 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i sku// kai lā sha yi snying por 'khrungs pa'am// ku mud rgod pa'i 'gran zlar 'ongs pa bzhin// nyi ma'i 'od gnon zhal ras sngon med kyi// zla ba gsar pa'i ngos su bris pa ltar// spyan zung in+d+ra nī la'i mdangs 'pho ba'i// sgros dmar bye ru'i yal 'dab shin tu dwangs// mthon mthing dbu skyes zur phud lngas rtsen par// ka nā ka yi pad mo tshar dngar bzhin// yid bzhin nor bu'i bar du spel ba yis// lha yi gar mkhan mdzes pa zum par byed// phyag g.yas brkyangs pa'i mchog sbyin phyag rgya dang*// g.yas min thugs ka'i thad du ut+pa la// ze'u 'brur sher phyin glegs bam chags pa yi// chu ba shing bal lta bur 'jam pa 'dzin// lhab lhub rin thang che ba'i gos bzang dar// sbyin mang nor bu'i do shal 'gran pa yis// sku yi cha rnams so sor bgo skal du// thob pa ji bzhin mdzes pa so sor snyoms// zhabs zung bka' rtags bzhi yi phab rgyu ni// rdo rje'i mdud pa'i tshul du bsnol byas nas// nam mkha'i mkhas gtugs bar du mi 'jig pa'i// skyil krung srid dang zhi ba'i bla na bcas// de yi gnas gsum rdo rje gsum rang bzhin// yig gsum dkar dmar sngo ba'i mdog can dang*// thugs kar 'khor lo rtsibs drug lte bar a// a las 'od zer phyogs bcu'i zhing du song*// 'phags mchog bsgoms pa ji bzhin spyan drangs te// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dgug cing gzhug pa dang*// bcings mnyes chu la grib gzugs 'phos pa bzhin /gnyis su dmigs pa'i mtshan ma dwangs par gyur// slar yang 'od kyis gdan gsum tshang ba yi// dbang lha spyan drangs dbang bskur bdud rtsi'i chus// sku gang chu lhag spyi bor 'khyil ba las// mi bskyod rigs kyi bdag pos mtshan par gyur// de ltar bsgoms pa'i lha sku gsal la rtag pa med par yun ring du mnyam par bzhag

drug pa ni/ lha'i thugs kar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs drug pa'i lte bar a/ rtsibs drug la mdun nas g.yas skor du/ oṃ wā kye daṃ na maḥzhes pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba klog pa'i tshul du bzla/ de la goms nas yig 'bru rnams 'khor lo las 'phags shing g.yon du 'khor/ 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor ba zla ba ltar 'tsher bas khams gsum gyi rmongs pa bcom/ shes rab kyi snang ba spel/ sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs bsdus te lha sngags la thim pas gzi byin bskyed par bsams la sngags bzla'o// bdun pa ni/ rang gi gre phug tu a yig dkar po gnas pa las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i skye 'phags rnams kyi mkhyen rab kyi dpal thams cad sngags kyi rnam par bsdus yig 'bru la thim pas slar yang a mang po 'phros rang sgra dang bcas lus kyi nang gtams par bsams te/ a/ brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bar du bgrang*/ brgyad pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ yig ni// yongs gyur rin chen snod kyi nang*// gtor ma 'bru gsum zhu ba las// zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ rang gi lus las ye shes pa// phyung ste nam mkhar bzhugs pa yi// ljags kyi pad+mo'i 'od zer gyis// drangs te bdud rtsi gsol bar gyur// oṃ ār+ya mañdzu shrī sa pa ri wā ra i maṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum gyis phul/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar sngags kho nas mchod/ bstod pa tsaṇ+ḍa go mī'i de'am gang blo mas bstod/ shes bya'i mkha' dbyings ma'am/ bsdu na brtse ldan khyod kyi sogs sh+lo kas 'dod don gsol ba btab cing*/ yi ge brgya pa dang ma 'byor pa sogs kyis nongs pa 'chags/ gshegs dang bzhugs pa'i mtshan ma las// rnam grol nyid na'ang byis pa'i ngor// rten dang tha dad ma yin par// mchog stsol slad du bzhugs su gsol// zhes sam badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol ba skabs dang sbyar/

bdag gi sgyu ma'i dge ba 'dis// sgyu ma lta bu'i skye bo kun// 'jam dpal rdo rje'i go 'phang la// myur du reg pa'i dpal thob shog /ces smon lam btab nas thun mtshams su sgyu ma lta bu'i lha dang sngags kyi rol par shes pa'i spyod lam bskyed do// 'dir mtshan ma'i nges pa dang las rab 'byams sgrub pa sogs ma bkod pas yig cha gzhan las shes par bya zhing*/ mtshams sgrub sogs kyi skabs bltas chog mar bkod pa 'di ni baṃ steng sprul sku'i nyams bzhes su phyogs bcu pa bstan pa'i nyin byed kyis rgyal gyi zla ba'i dbang phyogs rgyal ba gsum par spel ba'i dge bas 'gro rnams rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i nye rgyur chos rab rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi 'byor pa la 'dod dgur rtsen par gyur cig sarba dā shu bha bṛd+dhi rastu// ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ bha ga bān ār+ya mañdzu shrī pā dhiṣ+ṭhā na stu ti/ bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dbyangs phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba rnams kyis bstod par gyur mod de lta na'ang*// bsam pa blun po bla ma la gus dbang gis kyang ni khyod kyi yon tan bstod bgyi ste// rab tu dregs bcas ngang pa'i rgyal po sde dag gis brten chu dang bcas 'di yid bzhin mtshor// bzhad rnams kyang ni yid la rab tu dga' ba bzhag nas rgyu zhing rnam par gnas par bgyid// zur phud gsal ldan gser gyi snyan cha gdub kor gyis brgyan mgul ni rab tu sgeg bcas shing*// snyan gyi gong rgyan ut+pal mnga' slad khyod ni gzhon nur kun la grags pa de lta na'ang*// kun tu bzang po 'jig rten dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs rnga yab mdzes 'dzin pa'i// mkhas pa rnams kyis bla ma lta bur 'khor gyi nang du khyod ni bsten par gyur pa lags// do shal phreng ba sil sil sgrogs shing mchog tu nyams dga' snyan gdub mnga' ba spyi gtsug gi

/rin chen 'od mdzes 'phro ba dang ldan gzhon nu'i na tshod 'byung ba mnga' ba gang na'ang*// bcom ldan khyod ni gnas gsum dag na gus pas phyag bgyir 'os pa gcig pu nyid lags te// nyer zhi bkod gyur mchod pa 'os 'di gang na'ang de slad su zhig ngo mtshar skye mi 'gyur// shin tu rnam par 'gyur ba'i bzhin ldan sbrul stong dag gis gdu bur byas pa 'dzin mdzad cing*// rno ba'i mtshon bsnams g.yul ngor dpa' bo dang ldan gshin rje rnams ni 'jigs par mdzad pa yi// mi bzad pa yi 'phags pa gshin rje'i gshed dang bcas kyang khyod ni zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor te// cha yi tshogs kun yongs su rdzogs pa'i lus ldan ston ka'i zla ba lta bur gyur pa lags// khyod ni chos lam nye bar ston la mkhas kyang chos 'di 'ga' yang gzigs pa yod ma yin// khyod ni sems can phan la dgyes kyang sems can nyid ni 'ga' yang dmigs par gyur ma lags// bde gshegs dgyes pa phan tshun mi 'grig pa yi mdzad spyod mang po 'di dag 'gal bas na// khyod ni sa gsum ngo mtshar rgyu gcig gyur pa de slad khyod 'dir mnyes par gyur pa lags// gzhan phan 'bras bur ldan pas shing dang mtshungs shing rnam par gnas pa gangs chen lta bu ste// brtan pa yis ni lhun po dang 'dra grub pas bsten pas ri rgyal ma la ya dang mtshungs// gti mug rab rib zhi bar mdzad pa nyi ma bzhin te phun sum tshogs gzugs zla ba dang 'dra ba'i// mgon po gzhan gyi bya ba mdzad pa byis pa'i rol pa mdzad pas 'gro na rnam par rgyu// mchog tu dgyes pa'i ut+pal sngon po bsnams pas dri zhim gyis gos mtsho bran lta bu ste// shin tu rol pa'i spyod tshul dang ldan yul gyi byis pa lo brgyad lon pa dang 'dra zhing*// chos kyi char pa dri ma med pa 'bebs pas char sprin dag tu sgra sgrogs lta bu dang*// ngang pa'i rgyal po yid 'ong sgra skad zil mnan gsung mnga' khyod la su zhig rten mi byed// skad cig nyid la yongs su 'bar zhing rab rib sgrib g.yogs skad cig nyid la zad gyur pa// thams cad du ni legs pa'i lam ston bde gshegs sdig med mya ngan 'das par gyur pa na// gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin 'od zer stong phrag 'bar ba'i rgyan gyis legs par spras par gyur pa yi// khyod nyid gcig pu 'ba' zhig phyogs bcu rnams na da ltar snang ba nyid ni ma lags sam// mgon po kye ma khyod gzugs 'di na ras bris byas pas kyang ni ji ltar sim byed pa// ston ka'i mtshan mo dkar zhing rab tu mdzes pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lags te// ut+pal sngon po mdzes pa'i dri ngad zhim pos gos pa'i ser bu'i ngad kyang ma lags shing*// lha yi bu mos lag pas gtad pa'i ha ri tsan+dan dri zhim ldan pa'ang de lta min// gzhon nu khyod zhabs sen mo'i 'od zer phreng ba rgya chen mtshams su shar ba'i zla 'od bzhin// rab sdug dkar dmar mdog can rab sdud lha dang lha min gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od 'dres pas// ral pa can gyi mi gang la reg de dag kyang ni skye bo kun kyis phyag byar 'os// mgon po khyod kyi sngags 'dzin kha cig grub pa thob nas rab chags sgeg pa las byung ba'i// gom tshugs kyis 'gro rgyan phreng rkang gdub yid 'ong dang ldan mdzes ma brgya dang lhan cig tu// sa steng na rol gzhan dag kyang ni lha yi glang po tsan+dan rtul ba dang*// li shi'i me tog mdzes pas stug ldan sbrang mas dkrigs pa dga' ba'i nags tshal dag na lhags// na tshod gzhon zhing dregs dang bcas pas sgeg cing rnam par 'phrul pa gsal bar gyur pa yi// dri zhim po la chags shing skyong bar byed pa'i sbrang ma'i tshogs kyis dkrigs par byas gyur cing*// pi wang gling bu ngang rgyal sgra 'dra shin tu snyan pa'i dbyangs dang ldan gyur pa'i// gnod sbyin bu mo tshogs kyang khyod kyi gsang sngags bzlas pa yis ni rab tu 'gugs par byed// 'gro ba gsum gyi mgon po 'bras bu med pa'i mang du brjod pa dag gis ci bgyir mchi// khyod kyi yon tan rgya mtsho brjod par rnam kun thub pas kyang ni nus ma lags// kun nas dpag tu med pa'i chu dang ldan par gyur pa'i rgya mtsho phan tshun brgal ba'i phyir// mgon po sems dang bcas pa'i mi rnams dag las su zhig 'di ru 'jug par 'tshal bar bgyid// de ltar bcom ldan 'das ni 'phags pa 'jam dpal la yang mngon par bstod pa bgyis pa las// bdag gis dge ba gang zhig bsags pa de yis 'gro ba kun gyi rnyog pa zhi gyur cig

/de yis bdag kyang skye bar brtan zhing mtshungs pa med pa'i snyan dngags dang*// rigs dang ldan zhing tshe rabs dran dang snying rje rgya che ba dang mkhas rnams yid 'phrog par gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ snyan dngags mkhan rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu mkhas pa chen po slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mīs mdzad pa rdzogs so// rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ma ti kīrti dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba mkhas pa chen po mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis legs par bsgyur ba las/ slad kyi lho brag pa 'o rngu lo tsā ba dharma seng ges legs par gtan la phab pa// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
